## Get the course files {#files}

[vibing.jonasmoss.com]{style="font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: 800; color: #f0674d;"}

- Click **Marketing**. The **handout** is there, and **Course files** downloads it
  with the practice folders as one zip.
- Every prompt from the afternoon is in the handout, with a copy button, including
  what we don't get to. So are all the slides.
- **No paper with you?** The course files have one: a fictional paper in progress,
  with its data.
